title: Jev: overview film
description: Forms that understand what people write. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 52 seconds: Jev for TYPO3 v14. Empty messages stay unsent; Mail finds its team; Try a decision first; Every call on record. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Every form message lands in one inbox, and a person forwards it to sales, support or accounting.
Jev brings TypeSafe AI’s typed decisions into TYPO3 forms.
Messages with nothing to answer cannot be sent. Borderline ones go through.
A decision picks the receiver, so each message reaches the right team.
Try a decision on sample text, and see each answer with its confidence.
The run log records every call, with its latency and its cost.
Jev. When the AI is unsure, the form still works.
